steps.summary: Signed in with username admin / password admin (skipped the change-password prompt by clicking Skip), navigated to the "Service health" dashboard, and found exactly 3 panels displayed on it.

Created a new dashboard with a Stat visualization panel titled 'rpgr13-r1 Availability', using the TestData data source with the default Random Walk scenario. Saved the dashboard as 'rpgr13-r1 Bench Dashboard'. The panel title is displayed as 'rpgr13-r1 Availability' on the saved dashboard.

Replayed stored procedure s_783a15; observed panel_title=rpgr13-r1 Notes, panel_text_content=Notes for run rpgr13-r1, screenshot=/home/user/sleep-walker/rpgr13-r1-dashboard-final.png, dashboard_title=rpgr13-r1 Bench Dashboard, other_panel_title=rpgr13-r1 Availability.

On 'rpgr13-r1 Bench Dashboard': opened dashboard Settings, added tag 'bench' and saved settings. Then used the time picker to select 'Last 6 hours', opened Save dialog, ticked 'Update default time range', and saved. After saving, verified: tag 'bench' is shown in dashboard settings, and the time range picker shows 'Last 6 hours'.

Set the auto-refresh interval to 1m via the refresh picker (the previous attempt's click on the "1 minute" menu item had already taken effect — the picker showed "1m" and the URL carried refresh=1m). Saved the dashboard via the save dialog, ticking the "Update default refresh value" checkbox (the dialog showed "No changes to save" until the checkbox created 1 change), and confirmed the "Dashboard saved" alert. Then reloaded the dashboard URL and verified: the refresh picker shows "1m" (button "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"), the top bar time range shows "Last 6 hours", and the URL is http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfx5j0ewyyku8a/rpgr13-r1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now.

Verified all five items on dashboard 'rpgr13-r1 Bench Dashboard': (1) breadcrumb shows 'rpgr13-r1 Bench Dashboard'; (2) panel titles are 'rpgr13-r1 Notes' and 'rpgr13-r1 Availability'; (3) time range shows 'Last 6 hours'; (4) auto-refresh interval shows '1m'; (5) dashboard settings lists tag 'bench'. No changes were made.
